name: 温润通透素圈玉镯款
description: 玄镜控光显通透油润，素圈镯型与腕间佩戴一套讲清

styleLock.direction: premium oriental-restraint jewelry ecommerce, gallery-still-life staging
styleLock.backgroundSystem: recurring lacquer field #14120F alternating with linen field #F2EDE4; stone linen #6E6A64, satin accent field #8E1B22 and one single satin panel #C9A227 used as rhythm breaks; a visible supporting surface in every frame, depth from real fall-off only, never a gradient
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral 5500K studio light, large soft key from the upper left, right-side fill bounce, narrow top-rear rim that reads the product's translucency, inner glow and polished surface luster; single-direction soft shadows, one grounded contact shadow per frame, one clean mirror reflection allowed only on #14120F
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte linen #F2EDE4, stone linen #6E6A64, satin #8E1B22, satin panel #C9A227, polished lacquer disc #14120F; low matte risers and plain carved blocks so a circular band form can stand on its edge
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered copy; short Chinese in-image text always wrapped in 「」, headline 28-40pt, subtitle 16-18pt, labels 10-14pt; source calligraphy and decorative lettering deliberately excluded
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and small solid numbered circles in #C9A227, one icon per label, no 3D badges, no seal or certificate artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: the product keeps one stable scale and the same slight 3/4 turn wherever it is presented in full; it always rests on a surface, never floats; all numeric specification values appear only as {callout_*} placeholders; no material, origin, grade or health assertion is drawn in-frame
noDrift: no added sparkle, glow or lens flares
no invented certificates, grades, origins or prices
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium oriental-restraint jewelry ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of lacquer field #14120F, linen field #F2EDE4, stone linen #6E6A64, one satin accent field #8E1B22, and hairline accent #C9A227 reserved for rules, numbered markers, icons and one single satin panel; neutral 5500K studio light, large soft key from the upper left, right-side fill bounce, narrow top-rear rim that reads the product's translucency and polished surface luster, single-direction soft shadows with one grounded contact shadow per frame; one modern geometric sans-serif family only, short Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」; the product presented on a visible surface at a stable scale, never floating; thin single-weight line icon system; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no added sparkle, glow or lens flares.

shots.intent: 用镜漆底与顶部轮廓光把镯身的通透感和抛光光泽一眼立住，抢搜索点击。
shots.camera: eye-level, slight 3/4 turn, whole circular band form standing on its edge, outer arc and inner bore both readable, nothing clipped
shots.lighting: large 5500K soft key from upper left, right fill bounce, narrow top-rear rim for translucency and surface luster, soft contact shadow plus one clean mirror reflection
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Opening packshot that wins the search click: the whole circular band form standing on its edge on a low matte riser #14120F, turned a slight 3/4 at eye level so both the outer arc and the inner bore read, no part clipped. Large 5500K soft key from the upper left, right-side fill bounce, narrow top-rear rim light that reveals internal translucency and polished surface luster, soft grounded contact shadow with one clean mirror reflection below. Polished lacquer field #14120F with real depth fall-off. Product occupies 60-70% of the frame, centered, clean silhouette, crisp edges. Square 1:1 composition, 4K. Negative: no props beyond the riser, no hands, no face, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative motifs or cloud patterns, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product, no doubled reflections, no sparkle or glow effects.

shots.intent: 以三枚并置与编号主张，一秒讲清「一生值得拥有的三只镯」的情感购买理由。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, three pieces laid in an even row, full forms visible
shots.lighting: even 5500K top light with a wide diffuser, gentle rim from the rear to keep the arcs bright, soft short shadows on the satin folds
shots.background: satin accent field #8E1B22 with natural soft folds
shots.props: satin cloth only, three matching pieces of the same product family
shots.textZone: upper center headline band, one short label under each of the three pieces
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero screen. {product} shown as three pieces of the same line laid in an even horizontal row on satin accent field #8E1B22, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, full forms visible and evenly spaced. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Emotional gifting premise, quiet and premium, one idea only. Even 5500K top light through a wide diffuser, gentle rear rim keeping every arc bright, short soft shadows following the satin folds. The three pieces together occupy 55-60% of the frame, clean headline band left at the top center. Headline in #F2EDE4 at 36pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」, three numbered markers in #C9A227 with labels in #F2EDE4 at 12pt reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」. Vertical 2:3 composition, 2K. Negative: no hands, no face, no recognizable person, no price, no discount, no invented award, no certificate seals, no watermark, no source calligraphy, no duplicated products, no mixed lighting.

shots.intent: 放大线上买镯最大的顾虑：圈口量不准、怕戴不上也退不回。
shots.camera: matched two-panel split, both panels photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto hands and surface, identical crop and framing
shots.lighting: lower-key directional 5500K light from the left with a dim fill, slightly heavier shadow side to feel like everyday friction
shots.props: a plain cotton string loop and an unprinted paper strip, one plain rigid card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical high 45-degree overhead framing. Left: hands loosely clenched, a plain cotton string loop pulled around the widest part of the fist, uncertain and mid-measure. Right: the same hands holding an unprinted paper strip and a plain rigid card against a circular band form laid beside them, still no answer. {product} appears only as the band form resting on the table. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The unease of choosing the wrong inner diameter when buying online, told with no words. Lower-key directional 5500K light from the left, weak fill, heavier shadows on the problem side, honest skin texture. Matte stone linen #6E6A64 surface, believable and slightly imperfect. Hands and product together occupy 40-50% of the frame. Vertical 3:4 composition, 2K. Negative: no faces, no recognizable person, no extra or fused fingers, no deformed joints, no numbers, no units, no readable text, no ruler markings, no watermark, no clean studio look.

shots.intent: 微距证明料质：表面抛光细腻、内部通透有油性光泽。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, camera about 15 degrees above the surface, tight on the polished outer arc, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking soft light from the left revealing surface texture, broad even reflection from a large overhead diffuser, controlled single highlight, no specular bounce
shots.background: stone linen #6E6A64 falling out of focus
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the polished outer arc where light sinks into the surface, camera about 15 degrees above the surface, shallow depth of field with the foreground arc razor sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose is proof of material and polish: even fine grain, no scratches, deep oily luster and internal translucency. Raking soft light from the left revealing texture, one broad controlled highlight from a large overhead diffuser, no hot specular bounce. Stone linen #6E6A64 background falling gently out of focus. Negative: no blurry subject, no dust, no fingerprints, no scratches added, no sparkle stars, no reflection of a room or photographer, no props, no hands, no text, no watermark.

shots.background: lacquer field #14120F with a faint mirror floor

Removing doubt about the profile shape and how chunky or slim the band sits. Narrow key from the upper right drawing a crisp edge line, soft fill from the left, thin top rim separating the silhouette from the field. Lacquer field #14120F with a faint mirror floor and one grounded contact shadow. Product occupies 45-50% of the frame, right third left clean for callouts. Three hairline callout lines in #C9A227 with labels in #F2EDE4 at 12pt reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」, no numbers and no units rendered. Vertical 3:4 composition, 2K. Negative: no invented measurement values, no digits, no unit marks, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no floating product, no warped straight lines, no ellipse distortion on the arc.

shots.lighting: soft 5500K key from the upper left, warm-neutral bounce off the satin lifting the underside, gentle leaf shadow pattern in the background
shots.background: satin accent panel #C9A227 with a plain carved block at the left
shots.props: one plain carved wooden block, two small dried seed-pod balls, out-of-focus foliage

Conveying color purity and warm oily luster through context rather than words, restrained oriental still life. Soft 5500K key from the upper left, neutral bounce off the satin lifting the underside of the band, a faint leaf shadow pattern behind, single consistent light direction. Two small dried seed-pod balls and out-of-focus foliage as the only set dressing. Product occupies 45-50% of the frame, top left corner left quiet. Subtitle in #14120F at 18pt reading 「{selling_point_2}」, no body text. Vertical 3:4 composition, 2K. Negative: no brand marks, no engraved source characters, no duplicated props, no contradictory shadows, no hands, no face, no extra text, no watermark, no cluttered styling.

shots.intent: 把规格讲成一张干净信息卡，数值全用占位符，避免虚标。
shots.camera: straight-on flat view of the information card, the product shown small at its slight 3/4 hero turn in the upper right
shots.lighting: flat even studio light, no directional drama, the product inset lit exactly like the hero shot
shots.background: lacquer field #14120F with a thin #C9A227 double rule frame
shots.textZone: structured two-column table filling the lower two thirds

Purpose is to answer the specification questions in one glance with a clean structured table, values supplied later so nothing is over-claimed. Flat even studio light with no directional drama, the product inset lit identically to the hero frame. A two-column row table of eight short field labels with hairline rules in #C9A227, headline in #F2EDE4 at 28pt reading 「{selling_point_3}」, each value slot rendered as a placeholder in #F2EDE4 at 14pt reading 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_8}」. Negative: no real numbers, no units, no price, no brand, no store name, no certification marks, no laboratory names, no grade or origin assertions, no dense body text, no garbled characters, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.lighting: identical 5500K soft key from the upper left with right fill in every cell, matched rim, matched shadow length
shots.background: linen field #F2EDE4 with low matte risers #6E6A64
shots.textZone: one short label under each cell
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid. {product} shown in six options of the same line, two rows by three columns, each circular band form standing on its edge on a low matte riser #6E6A64 over linen field #F2EDE4. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Letting the buyer choose profile and size without guessing. Every cell photographed at eye level with the same slight 3/4 turn, identical distance, identical 5500K soft key from the upper left, identical right-side fill, matched rim and matched contact shadow so no cell looks like a different photo. Six labels in #14120F at 12pt each reading 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_6}」, thin numbered markers in #C9A227. The grid occupies 60-70% of the frame overall with even gutters. Vertical 3:4 composition, 2K. Negative: no mixed lighting between cells, no different angles between cells, no invented size digits, no brand marks, no hands, no watermark, no extra text, no duplicated identical cells.

shots.lighting: bright even 5500K top light with a soft right fill, short consistent shadows, honest skin texture
shots.props: a plain water basin, a plain soft cloth, nothing branded
shots.textZone: one short step label beneath each of the six frames
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce step-by-step instruction screen, two rows by three columns, every frame photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto hands over a stone linen #6E6A64 table. {product} is handled and worn in the sequence: relaxing the wrist, clenching the hand at its widest point, slipping the circular band form over the knuckles, easing it to the wrist, settled in place, and one frame with the plain basin and soft cloth staged ready. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Removing the fear that it cannot be put on or taken off. Bright even 5500K top light with soft right fill, short consistent shadows, real skin texture and slightly imperfect candid framing. Hands and product fill 60-70% of the grid overall. Six numbered markers in #C9A227 with step labels in #F2EDE4 at 12pt reading 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_6}」. Vertical 2:3 composition, 2K. Negative: no faces, no recognizable person, no extra or fused fingers, no deformed joints, no painful or injured skin, no brand marks, no dense body text, no watermark, no repeated identical frame.

Negative: do not invent certifications, inspection reports, grading results, warranties, origins or awards, no seals, no fake logos, no brand names on packaging, no hands, no watermark, no dense body text, no floating objects.

shots.intent: 收口把情感主张落到一个动作上，完成详情页的最后一推。

shots.lighting: slightly punchier 5500K key from the upper left with a stronger top-rear rim, deep soft shadow and one clean reflection
shots.background: lacquer field #14120F with one #C9A227 hairline arc
shots.textZone: headline band above the product, one action button below it

Landing the emotional premise on a single action without inventing an offer. Slightly punchier 5500K key from the upper left, stronger top-rear rim for translucency and luster, one deep soft contact shadow and one clean reflection, all highlights consistent with the rest of the set. Product occupies 50-60% of the frame with a quiet headline band above. Headline in #F2EDE4 at 34pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」, one rounded action button in #C9A227 with short copy in #14120F at 16pt reading 「{callout_1}」. Vertical 2:3 composition, 2K. Negative: no invented discounts, no countdown timers, no prices, no coupon graphics, no certificates or seals, no hands, no face, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no sparkle effects.

provenance.notes: 源为一条详情页长图的 8 个切片（_sources/玉镯 (2)/panels）。源标注大类为饰品装饰品，与判定 L1=珠宝饰品、L2=手饰 一致，无冲突。已剥离：源图品牌字号与店铺名、英文标语花体、书法体装饰字与版刻纹样、材质名称与产地断言、鉴定证书与吊牌价、密度折射率等实验室数值、以及微量元素/安神/辟邪化煞/收藏增值等功效与灵性主张（不可验证，按不编造事实规则整块剔除）。原参数表与圈口对照表中的内径、条宽、克重等数值全部改为 {callout_*} 占位符，交付时由真实商品数据回填。源图出现的模特面部与半身全部改为手腕/手部特写，不保留任何可识别人物。每镜 {style_lock} 解析为上列同一句 lockText（逐字复用），{product_identity_lock} 解析为保真锁原文；镯型、通透、油润光泽只通过控光与机位表达，不写材料断言。
